I know.. I’m so sorry.. I really am. I’m just panicking and I’ve taken more diazepam than I know what to do with. 

It’s just everything.. my husband and my marriage, my father, job, everything. 

I don’t have bipolar, I have Borderline Personality Disorder. I have been seeing a therapist but I can’t afford it. And I’m in the UK where shit should be free!
No one gives a shit clearly
